decisions.topic: Native account removal and synced Setup tombstones

decisions.answer: Any browser expires a tombstone 30 days after its edit time, during an automatic receive pass with sync on, dropping its local copy and removing the synced copy in a separate cleanup turn. Filter tombstones go with their Setup's. ARC-MOD-21 gains an exception.
